facts.text: Rosewood Courchevel sits at the top of the village of Courchevel 1850.
facts.excerpt: At the top of the exclusive village of Courchevel 1850, Rosewood Courchevel offers an exceptional ski retreat.

facts.text: The hotel has direct access to the piste.
facts.excerpt: Direct access to the piste, unrivaled accommodations and dedicated ski butlers

facts.text: The hotel has dedicated ski butlers.
facts.excerpt: Direct access to the piste, unrivaled accommodations and dedicated ski butlers

facts.text: SALTO is the restaurant at the heart of the property, with alpine views.
facts.excerpt: At the heart of the property sits SALTO, where expressive flavors and warm conviviality unfold against sweeping alpine views.

facts.text: SALTO serves alpine flavors with views of the Courchevel slopes.
facts.excerpt: Alpine flavors with views of the Courchevel slopes

facts.text: The Jardin Alpin Apartment is a four-bedroom residence with an elevator entrance, expansive terraces, a cinema room, a professional kitchen and outdoor and indoor dining for 12.
facts.excerpt: A grand four-bedroom residence, with elevator entrance, expansive terraces, cinema room and professional kitchen, as well as outdoor and indoor dining options for 12.

facts.text: The Courchevel Two-Bedroom House has a super king bed and four spacious terraces with views of the chalets.
facts.excerpt: Featuring a super king bed and four spacious terraces with views of the chalets

facts.text: The Saulire Two-Bedroom House has lofty ceilings and five terraces framing views of Saulire.
facts.excerpt: With two bedrooms, lofty ceilings and five terraces framing views of Saulire

facts.text: The Saulire House living area is set for fireside gatherings.
facts.excerpt: A spacious living area sets the scene for cosy fireside gatherings.

facts.text: Check-in is from 4:00 p.m. and check-out is before 11:00 a.m.
facts.excerpt: Check-in is from 4:00 p.m., and check-out is before 11:00 a.m.

facts.text: The hotel is smoke-free in all indoor areas.
facts.excerpt: Rosewood Courchevel Le Jardin Alpin maintains a smoke-free environment in all indoor areas

facts.text: A baby crib is available free of charge in selected room categories for guests under 3.
facts.excerpt: A baby crib is available free of charge in selected room categories for guests aged under 3 years old.

facts.text: A deposit of 50% of the total stay is required to confirm a booking.
facts.excerpt: A deposit of 50% of the total stay is required to confirm the booking

facts.text: The hotel describes its accommodations as unrivaled.
facts.excerpt: Direct access to the piste, unrivaled accommodations and dedicated ski butlers
